notes:
Lead came inbound via pricing page form. Early-stage SMB building support bot for 3 midsize ecommerce brands. Key points:
- Wants hosted API (self-serve), quick onboarding, low ops.
- Primary goal: reduce average handle time and deflect chat volume to bot for common returns/refund flows.
- Latency target: P95 < 350ms for single-turn assistance (chat), throughput modest (peak ~15rps).
- Cost sensitivity high; currently allocating $500/mo for API services.
- Model preference: open to small-footprint LLM (gpt-style) — lowest latency/price tradeoff.
- Needs basic audit logging and SOC2 attestation for vendor. No residency or SSO requirement today.
- Failed/failed-ish POC: got key, tried Node sample; misconfigured env -> 401 -> rotated key -> low follow-through.
- Competitor churn risk: mentioned a competitor (OpenAI promo) offering free credits and easier per-message pricing; considering switching if we don't show value quickly.
- Quote from Maya: 'The latency was promising but our cost forecast with current token burn looks off; can you show per-session estimates with caching?'
sales_playbook_recs: Offer 2-week trial top-up ($200 credit) tied to a short 'brown-bag' session on caching/prompt templates. Provide quick cost-estimation sheet and sample Node snippet for session caching. Escalate if they ask for committed pricing.
internal_risks: High — inbound SMB with low ops bandwidth. If no quick ROI demonstration, likely to switch to competitor credits. No enterprise procurement path expected.
notes_short: Inbound SMB trial; issued key, low usage, price-sensitive, competitor promo mentioned. Offer credit + cleanup doc.
